policy.target: POST /api/v1/auth/register, POST /api/v1/auth/login, POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, POST /api/v1/auth/logout, GET /api/v1/projects, POST /api/v1/projects, GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/messages, POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/chat, POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/generate, GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/generate/status, GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/documents, SCR-001 -> SCR-002 -> SCR-003, and Non-functional requirements NFR-001 to NFR-007
policy.environment: Docker Compose on VPS with PostgreSQL and Redis, Python 3.13 FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend
policy.out_of_scope: Code auto-generation, Jira/Notion integration, multi-tenant permission management, voice input, multi-user simultaneous editing
policy.done_criteria: All integration tests for APIs and system tests for screens and non-functional requirements pass successfully.

system.steps: 1. Open SCR-001, register and login. 2. Navigate to SCR-002, create a project with reference files, chat with AI. 3. Navigate to SCR-003, trigger document generation, check progress, view preview, copy and download Markdown documents and check AI self-diagnosis results.
system.expected: User successfully completes the end-to-end workflow from authentication, project creation, chat hearing, to document generation and preview across SCR-001, SCR-002, and SCR-003.

system.steps: Simulate a system outage or maintenance downtime and measure recovery time / check maintenance window during night time.
system.expected: System downtime is within half a day, and night-time maintenance halts are acceptable per NFR-001.

system.steps: Execute daily database backup script, verify that 7 days of backups are retained, and confirm copies are stored outside the VPS.
system.expected: Backups are successfully created daily, retained for 7 days, and stored externally per NFR-002.

system.steps: Simulate simultaneous usage by several to dozens of users. Measure the time for the first chat character to appear and the time for 4 documents generation.
system.expected: First chat character appears within a few seconds, and 4 document generation completes within a few minutes under concurrent load of several to dozens of users per NFR-003.
system.precondition: Concurrent user load simulation tool ready

system.steps: Check monitoring and error tracking configuration
system.expected: Error tracking and health checks are confirmed to be deferred/not introduced for MVP per NFR-004.
Confirmed that there are no data or systems to migrate per NFR-005.

system.steps: Inspect application log files after user inputs sensitive chat content and personal info.
system.expected: Input contents and confidential info are not present in logs; only error presence and timestamps are recorded per NFR-006.
system.precondition: Application generating logs during user chat and input

system.steps: Access the application using latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari on PC, and review viewing capability on smartphones.
system.target: システム環境・エコロジー
system.expected: Application functions correctly on PC latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari, and allows sufficient viewing on smartphones per NFR-007.

integration.steps: Send POST request with body {"email": "test@example.com", "password": "Password123!"}
integration.expected: HTTP 201 Created. User data is saved in PostgreSQL.

integration.steps: Send POST request with invalid email format and short password {"email": "invalid-email", "password": "short"}
integration.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Data is not saved.

integration.steps: Send POST request with {"email": "test@example.com", "password": "Password123!"}
integration.expected: HTTP 409 Conflict. Data is not duplicated or saved.

integration.steps: Send excessive rapid POST requests exceeding rate limit
integration.expected: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header.

integration.steps: Send POST request with empty body or empty fields {"email": "", "password": ""}
integration.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Data is not saved.

integration.steps: Send POST request with {"email": "test@example.com", "password": "Password123!"}
integration.expected: HTTP 200 OK. Returns Access Token in response body and sets Refresh Token in HttpOnly Cookie.
integration.precondition: Registered user with email "test@example.com" and password "Password123!"

integration.steps: Send POST request with incorrect password {"email": "test@example.com", "password": "WrongPassword!"}
integration.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized. Access Token is not returned.

integration.steps: Send multiple failed login attempts exceeding rate limit
integration.expected: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header.

integration.steps: Send POST request with empty email and empty password fields
Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/refresh with the Cookie
integration.expected: HTTP 200 OK with new Access Token returned.
integration.precondition: Valid Refresh Token stored in HttpOnly Cookie

integration.steps: Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/refresh
integration.precondition: No Refresh Token or expired/invalid Refresh Token in Cookie

integration.steps: Send POST request with empty Cookie / missing token
Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/logout with Authorization header
integration.expected: HTTP 200 OK. Refresh token is invalidated in Redis/DB.
